entities.summary: John Bonaventure Kwofie, C.S.Sp. is an archbishop, professed member of the Spiritan Order, prelate, theologian, and philosopher for the Catholic Church in Ghana who has been the metropolitan archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Accra. Previously, he served as the bishop of the Diocese of Sekondi-Takoradi.
